scope: Cutting v1 vs independent Smart2D analysis v1; not original Smart2DCutting executable
comparisonRule: Count higher part-area/used-stock-area utilization and lower nonreusable-loss/used-stock-area loss rate independently. Compare material only for identical per-part fulfillment; record opposing winners as tradeoff. Percentage tolerance 1e-7 percentage points. No timing is measured.
lossDefinition: Used stock - placed parts - reusable remnants = trim + kerf + small unusable remnants. Reusable requires both dimensions >= per-case minRemnant.
